d: Long, flowing amethyst-purple hair with a side part and soft waves, paired with almond-shaped eyes of a matching purple hue and a gentle expression. The face is that of a young adult with a mature, serene composure, featuring pointed elven ears and a slender build. The outfit is a high-waisted, floor-length gown in white and teal with gold accents, complemented by white gloves and white lilies tucked into the hair and held in one hand. This humanoid figure is merged with a massive, spiral nautilus shell in shades of deep teal, seafoam green, and ochre, which serves as a backdrop and structural element of the design. BODY COLOR: Pale cream LEGS: Plantigrade, though obscured by the flowing fabric of the gown.
